description: Tutorial lesson T3 (Get Movin'), mouse+keyboard player path: menu -> picker -> lesson boots from tutorial_postdeploy -> disembark the Boyz+Warboss from the Battlewagon via the real row-click + ConfirmationDialog + 11 placement clicks inside the 3-inch ring -> the boyz_move_after_disembark step teaches that the disembarked unit still gets its own move because the wagon has not moved yet (drag a Boy, End This Unit's Move) -> Advance the Battlewagon through the mode radio + Confirm Movement Mode gate -> move the hull in TWO drags (asserting the second adds to the first, which is what the step now tells the player) -> turn it with Q held mid-drag on the 'POINT IT RIGHT!' step -> End This Unit's Move -> End Movement Phase under a strict spotlight -> summary, completion persisted, back to menu.

steps.comment: OK on the native ConfirmationDialog - its internal button has no scene path for click_node
19.03: the attached Warboss disembarks WITH the Boyz. Before the fix the placement only asked for the 10 Boyz, reported complete, and left the Warboss aboard.
The Warboss model is actually ON THE BOARD at a placed position, not merely flagged as disembarked
Battlewagon is empty — neither the Boyz nor the Warboss are left inside
11e 18.04 - a tactical disembark from a transport that has NOT moved leaves the unit selected to make its own move; the new step teaches that affordance
m1 is at board (480,500) after placement - drag it 40px (1") forward, well inside the 6" cap and coherency
staging a model must NOT advance the step - it waits for the move to be locked in
the Boy really moved - guards against a zero-distance stage passing for a move (staged moves only reach GameState on CONFIRM_UNIT_MOVE, so this reads the live move data)
confirming the move wrote the new position through to GameState
Keep Roll lives inside an embedded Window (AcceptDialog) - real-coordinate clicks into embedded windows are unreliable, the schema's emit_pressed escape hatch exists for this

steps.script:
var o = tree.root.get_node("/root/TutorialOverlay")
return o.current_body_text().contains("grab it again")
steps.comment: the card must actually SAY the move can be spent over several drags - players were treating the drag as one-shot and burning the whole move by accident
first hop - deliberately only part of the way, the second drag below proves the rest of the move is still there
the first hop is 60 board px = 1.5in of a 12in+D6 advance, i.e. a small fraction of the move - the second drag below is shown to ADD to this rather than replace it
the turn step must name the actual rotate keys - {key:rotate_left}/{key:rotate_right} render through KeybindingManager, so an unresolved token would read '{key:rotate_left}' and fail this
the wagon enters the step un-rotated, so the delta the step's done-leaf watches for is unambiguous

second hop AND the rotation in one grab: Q only rotates a model that is currently held (MovementController clears selected_model on drop), which is exactly what the step tells the player to do - grab, hold, tap Q/E, let go

steps.script:
var u = GameState.get_unit("U_BATTLEWAGON_T")
return abs(float(u.models[0].get("rotation", 0.0)) + PI / 6.0) < 0.01
steps.comment: two Q taps = -2 * PI/12 = -PI/6 rad (-30 degrees), i.e. the 15-degrees-a-tap the prompt promises

multi-step movement proven: two 1.5in hops read back as 3.0in, so the second drag ADDED to the first instead of replacing it - a replace would still read 1.5in here. This is exactly what step 6's new wording claims
